Osteomalacia\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is an online E log book to discuss our patient's de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian's signed informed consent.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHere we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patient's clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis E log book also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI've been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECASE\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003EA 30yr old female, Daily wage Labourer by occupation came to OPD with cheif complaints of\u003Cdiv\u003EPain in B\/L Lower limbs since 2 years.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 2 yrs back after which she developed lowback ache initially which is Insidious in onset and gradually Progressive. Over the period of this 2 years it progressed and involved Both the lower limbs to such an extent that she stopped her daily work and needed an aid for walking since 1 year.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPain was Dragging type and aggrevated during work and relieved with rest and medication.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient gives history of NSAID use on \u0026amp; off at the times of pain in the past 2 years.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/O radiation\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo H\/O associated Tingling \u0026amp; Numbness in lower limbs\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E(H\/O Tingling in UL occasionally)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe is not a k\/c\/o DM, HTN, Asthma, Epilepsy, TB, Thyroid, CAD, CVD\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EH\/O Multiple Hospital visits where she was told to have Hypokalemia and adviced POTCLOR Syrup for 6 months but she used ot only for 2 months.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EShe underwent 2 LSCS' and Tubectomy in the past\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHer Menses are Regular and bleeding was normal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHer Sleep was adequate, Appetite Normal, Diet is Mixed, B\u0026amp;B are regular.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient gives a H\/O Unintentional Weight loss (?Kgs)\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Ctable align=\"center\" cellpadding=\"0\" cellspacing=\"0\" class=\"tr-caption-container\" style=\"margin-left: auto; \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cb\u003EA 70yr OLD MALE WITH DENGUE SHOCK SYNDROME\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis is an online E log book to discuss our patient's de-identified health data shared after taking his\/her\/guardian's signed informed consent.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHere we discuss our individual patient's problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patient's clinical problems with collective current best evidence based inputs.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis E log book also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI've been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \"patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with a diagnosis and treatment plan\u003C\/p\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003EA 70yr old male, agriculture by occupation was brought to casualty in an Unconscious state since yesterday\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 1 week back after which he started Binge drinking for 2 days and then he developed Fever that last for 3 days and developed Abdominal pain Burning type both for which he was treated by local Doctor.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAfter that he developed weakness which is gradual in onset and was unable to stand for which he was admitted to loacl hospital where he was diagnosed to have DENGUE FEVER (through NS1 ANTIGEN Positive) and the Platelet Count was 24,000.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHe Wasn't responding for commands since yesterday evening and became unconscious since yesterday night and he was brought here to our hospital today morning.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr \/\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient is a known case of Chronic Alcoholism since 30 years and increased his intensity since last
